items.title: 68088_Wilbur B. Ware, Sr oral history interview
items.q: Tony Turner say, 'You guys are cats going to get fired.' I say, 'For what, man?'

ctx.x: Monk, Blackwell, Charlie Rouse (PHONETIC) and I think that was the last time Charlie worked with T. Thelonius was kind of ill and he was saying things that really hurt Charles' feelings, but we made the weekend -- no, we made that week and then Monk went into the hospital. This was all '68 mostly. And I'm working down at Slugs with different little groups and I worked with Sonny Rollins down at the Vanguard. Al Foster, Al Daley (PHONETIC), myself.

I know one night Tony Williams was in the house. Miles was in the house, too, you know. He was kind of in his bag. He was, you know, just standing around. He was speaking and whatnot. Sonny was staring standing off into space and Al Foster and I come out -- we had a beautiful set -- come off the stand, come back in the kitchen. Tony Turner say, "You guys are cats
going to get fired." I say, "For what, man?" He say, "You're playing too much."
